name: IEC pushbutton contact: normally open push button positive make
aliases: pushbutton contact Normally Open Push Button Positive Make
summary: Pushbutton contact form: Normally Open Push Button Positive Make.
description: A pushbutton translates a person pressing an operator into a change of electrical contact state. The operator form and the contact state are separate pieces of information, so a mushroom head can operate either a normally-open or a normally-closed contact. This entry identifies the normally open push button positive make form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

On a machine control sheet, this form lets the reader distinguish the physical button action from the contact used by the controller. Link every contact block to the same operator tag, including a separate indication lamp when fitted. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The positive-make qualifier identifies a mechanically imposed closing action; it must not be confused with a positive-opening contact indication.

The head shape and contact drawing do not establish a safety category, contact rating or emergency-stop suitability. Direct opening, reset behaviour and the selected assembly must be confirmed from its documentation.
